title: Reversible plastic placemats
text: Reversible plastic placemats. I purchased 4 different sets from this brand Counterart - the colors are bright and colorful - clear prints.  You get 4 - I wish there were 6 - but didn't want to purchase 8 (2 sets). They are plastic-ish and wipe off well. Time will tell if they stand up to the wear -  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: CounterArt Monterey Bay Turtle 4 Pack Reversible Easy Care Flexible Plastic Placemats Made in The USA BPA Free PVC Free Easily Wipes Clean
features: REVERSIBLE FLEXIBLE PLASTIC- Placemats are reversible. Each Placemat features a coordinating different design on each side. Placemats are constructed of BPA and PVC free flexible plastic. The flexibility of these Placemats makes for easy clean up. Easily funnel crumbs or meal remnants from the table to the trash receptacle. Then wipe the Placemat clean with soap and water.

PROTECTS YOUR SURFACES- Placemats protect your table or countertop from spilled food, scratches, or stains. Placemat material prevents liquids from soaking through to your surfaces which may cause water rings or damage.

PROUDLY MADE IN THE USA - Placemats are constructed in our Florida facility. Each purchase supports hard working American families and communities. Placemats feature print in white with a solid color background. Attractive coordinating designs are great for everyday meals, parties and outdoor entertaining.

ARTISTIC DESIGN- Beautiful artistic design allow the Placemats to remain displayed even when not in use. Leading, Trending Artists in the industry work with us to create artistic designs that will add beauty and distinction to your Dining Space. Decorative Placemats are an easy way to change the look of your kitchen, dining room, or outdoor eating area.

MEASURES- Each Placemat measures 17.13” x 11.25” x 0.15”. Size allows for plate, drinkware, and utensils to fit nicely on the Placemat. Look for CounterArt coordinating Coasters, Lazy Susan Turntables, and Cutting Boards to complete your home design.
